title: Chapter 1458
text:
The light of the Multi-Dimensional Sky Opening Transportation Device faded from his sight, and the scene outside the portholes of the player battleships had already turned into an incomparably vast green world. The enormous World Tree stood in the distance, and the endless World Tree fleet surrounded it like a green sea of light.

The distribution of the World Tree troops appeared in front of them. It was as if they covered every inch of space, and it was extremely strict. It was enough to arouse the fear of ordinary people and make their scalps go numb.

Countless ship-borne weapons adjusted their cannons at the same time and aimed at the direction where the players appeared. They could spit out endless firepower at any time and smash the invaders into pieces.

It was as if they could smell the thick aura of death, but the players were not afraid at all. Instead, their blood boiled, and a trembling fanaticism surged in their chests.

"Hahahaha! Little trees, you have such a day too!"

"Brothers, charge!"

"For the tribe!"

"The sacred forum is connected to us!"

"Wahahaha, die for me!"

Tens of millions of players shouted excitedly and dispersed!

Batches of warships that had arrived through teleportation split up without any hesitation. They scattered like sparks in the sky and charged in all directions, like a group of happy huskies.

"Fire!"

Following the Ancestral Tree King's brazen order, countless cannons suddenly fired, forming a tsunami of light cannons that had almost no gaps. A wave slammed down, instantly shattering a large number of players along with their shields and ships, turning them all into dust!

In just a single exchange, the player fleet suffered huge casualties!

However, a portion of the Multi-Dimensional Sky Opening Transportation Devices operated in groups, forming a teleportation chain that operated all day long. New troops were teleported out every moment, and the remaining Multi-Dimensional Sky Opening Transportation Devices operated in groups, specifically responsible for large-scale deployment. The two teleportation methods worked together to ensure that there would be no shortage of troops at the frontline.

A large number of players died in battle, and new players continued to enter, bringing back detailed information about the World Tree's main dimension … Due to the restriction of information communication, it was difficult for normal scouting troops to send information to the headquarters, and the players who could revive were the most unrestricted intelligence agents.

The firepower of the World Tree army was endless, blasting the enemy ships into fireworks. However, at this moment, the players suddenly stopped teleporting and were replaced by densely packed Keys of Destruction.

"Shield!"

The roars of all levels of commanders sounded in the World Tree's mental network, and the outermost defense circle immediately activated its countermeasures. Space extended, lengthening the distance, turning into a deep area used to buffer the bombardment. It was the Lerbo Space Protection Belt.

The next moment, the batches of Keys of Destruction that had been thrown over burst forth with blinding light, as if hundreds of thousands of suns had risen. Violent energy poured out like a flood that had been opened!

Boom boom boom boom — —

The high-density energy reaction caused the space to distort. The source of the explosion seemed to have become a singularity. The surrounding space and time collapsed, showing a vortex-like spatial fold.

Radiance that seemed to be able to split the heavens and earth burst forth, spreading rapidly. It only slowed down after entering the Lerbo Space Protection Belt, like a wave rolling onto a beach, gradually slowing down. In the end, it barely touched the anti-bombing giant shield of the outer defense circle, exploding with strong electric arcs, leaving large cracks on the shield.

The cleansing of the Keys of Destruction was repeated many times, and most of its power was reduced by the space protection belt. The remaining power shattered the layers of protective shields, causing considerable damage to the World Tree fleet in the outermost defense circle. However, the maintenance fleet penetrated the position and kept repairing the shield, causing the effect of the Keys of Destruction's bombardment to stop at the outer defense circle.

If it was an ordinary secondary dimension, it would have long burst from the inside under the energy explosion of this level. However, the toughness of the World Tree's main dimension far exceeded common sense, and the strength of its space was even greater than that of the main universe. Furthermore, it was reinforced by the World Tree fleet with a large number of space devices, making it extremely sturdy.

The players explored the path and used the Keys of Destruction to cleanse the ground several times, scraping off the World Tree battleships one after another. The battleships further inside kept moving forward to fill in the gaps and maintain the shield. One side was being bombarded, while the other side was defending.

After another batch of Keys of Destruction exploded, the official troops of the Galactic Alliance Army finally arrived, wave after wave.

Due to the limitations of the teleportation efficiency, the mission of the vanguard troops was to withstand the attacks of the World Tree and buy time for the follow-up troops. They would allow the Multi-Dimensional Sky Opening Transportation Device to continuously release troops until there were enough troops present. The first phase of the mission would be considered a success, and only then would they be able to enter the next phase of the large-scale battle.

The Galactic Alliance Army that was present immediately took action. The division of labor was clear. The engineering team established a position and built a space gate. They wanted to connect to the main universe and add new channels for troops to be deployed. The guards surrounded the area, preparing to defend against the World Tree's attack. The mission of harassing and attacking was temporarily handed over to the Spacetime Splicing Suicide Squad.

The Lerbo Space Protection Belt was used as a depth zone to lengthen the space distance and separate the two sides. As a result, the Galactic Alliance Army needed to travel for a long time to pass through this area and reach the outermost defense circle of the World Tree.

However, on the other hand, if the World Tree wanted to attack the Galactic Alliance Army, it did not need to travel through the Lerbo Space Protection Belt and could directly teleport. This was because this was the main dimension of the World Tree, and it had the function of the 'World Tree Express'. All the members of the World Tree had the ability to quickly teleport here and could appear in any corner at any time.

The World Tree Civilization had the home ground advantage here, making it easy to defend and difficult to attack.

The next moment, green lights flashed, and batches of the World Tree's mobile fleets appeared, directly crossing the Lerbo Space Protection Belt.

Looking at the dense army of the three Universal Civilizations outside the window, the countless World Tree soldiers looked as if they were facing death. The mental network was filled with tragic emotions.

Although their thoughts were controlled by the World Tree, the members of the World Tree still had their own consciousness and treated the World Tree as a totem. They only had one thought left, and that was to repel the counterattack of the three Universal Civilizations at all costs.

"For the mother tree! Kill all the enemies! "

The World Tree soldiers let out shrill battle cries and controlled their battleships to attack.

"Stop them!"

The officers of the Galactic Alliance Army also roared and gave orders.

One side was filled with the anger of avenging their compatriots, while the other side was filled with the determination to fight to the death. The strong collective consciousness clashed and entangled into a mental undercurrent that wreaked havoc on the entire battlefield. Countless people felt like they were seeing two giant beasts biting each other.

Then, the military formation of both sides collided. In an instant, it was as if the sky was collapsing!

As soon as they exchanged blows, the situation was one-sided. Due to the huge difference in strength, the World Tree fleet quickly gained the upper hand and broke through the Galactic Alliance Army's formation on a large scale.

The vanguard of the Galactic Alliance Army struggled to hold on. The pressure did not only come from the huge number of enemy troops stationed in the main body dimension but also from the harassment of the World Tree's main body.

Every time the fresh troops of the Galactic Alliance Army were teleported to the battlefield, spatial rifts would appear around them, and densely packed World Tree Roots would extend out and attack their army formation, shattering starships one after another.

In the main body dimension, the mother tree's consciousness could control the World Tree Roots to block the enemy. Its lethality might not be strong, but it was definitely a sharp method to disrupt the battle.

The special technology troops of the World Tree and the Galactic Alliance Army did not rest either. Sometimes, they used genetic bombs, sometimes, they used dimensional space weapons, and sometimes, they used network viruses. All kinds of technologies were displayed one after another. They fought back and forth and countered each other's moves.

Batch after batch of fleets were sacrificed, and more troops were teleported over. The number of troops increased and decreased like a roller coaster, but the overall trend was still rising. The speed of the battle losses was not as fast as the speed of the Multi-Dimensional Sky Opening Transportation Device.

The armies of both sides fought fiercely, and the battlefield was extremely chaotic. Their formations were intertwined, and they fought head-on. There were millions of casualties every second, and the number of sacrifices was being refreshed at a terrifying speed.

…

"Attack, attack! We can't let the enemy tarnish the mother tree! "

Fanatical fighting spirit spread through the mental network, infecting all the members of the World Tree.

However, no matter how agitated they were, they could not decide the direction of the battle.

The two sides had been fighting for a long time, and the Galactic Alliance Army had already passed the most dangerous initial stage. At this moment, the troops present had already reached a certain scale, and they gradually got rid of the disadvantage and began to fight against the World Tree fleet.

In the chaotic battlefield, a World Tree mobile battleship nimbly shuttled through the barrage of bullets, teleporting from time to time to dodge the attacks that had no blind spots. It kept shooting out a series of light energy missiles, shattering the enemy ships like whips.

The pilot gritted his teeth, and his eyes were bloodshot.

As they approached a Galactic Alliance Army combat team, the firepower covered them. The pilot immediately activated teleportation, and the entire spaceship disappeared from the spot, dodging a round of firepower.

The next moment, his spaceship appeared in the center of this team. The pilot did not hesitate to remove the limiter of the reactor, turning the entire spaceship into a large bomb, wanting to self-destruct and eliminate this group of enemy teams.

However, at this moment, an invisible force field suddenly pressed down, crushing his spaceship into dust. His furious bellow that he had yet to let out was suppressed into nothingness.

In the growing army formation of the Galactic Alliance Army, hundreds of Beyond Grade As appeared together, and justice descended from the heavens, instantly destroying a large number of World Tree troops that were attacking.

An enormous Mechanical Deity was also exposed in front of both sides, emitting Transcendent Grade energy fluctuations. It was Han Xiao's Supreme Heavenly Venerate, and its strong presence instantly attracted the attention of all the soldiers and officers on both sides.

The members of the World Tree already had a psychological shadow over Han Xiao, and countless people felt a chill in their hearts.

On the other hand, the soldiers of the Galactic Alliance Army were overjoyed.

"Attention, the Beyond Grade A Association has moved out! The official counterattack! "

The entrance of the high-level combatants was a signal, which meant that the strategy had entered the second stage, from defense to offense.

The Galactic Alliance Army had accumulated enough troops and no longer focused on defense. They finally launched a fierce counterattack, charging toward the World Tree's main body from all directions.

"The Lerbo Space Protection Belt can stop them for a long time. The enemy won't be able to break into our official defense circle for a while. We can use the deeper areas to deal more damage to them …"

Seeing this, the same thought flashed through the minds of the World Tree members, but the next moment, their expressions changed.

Han Xiao's Supreme Heavenly Venerate raised his arm and clenched it in the direction of the World Tree fleet's defense circle. A strange spatial fluctuation was released, instantly covering the Lerbo Space Protection Belt.

The next moment, the Lerbo Space Protection Belt quickly lost its effect, and the extended space quickly shrank back to normal.

However, that was not all. Originally, even if the Lerbo Space Protection Belt had lost its effect, there was still a distance between the two armies. However, with the sudden contraction, the large army of the Galactic Alliance Army was right in front of the defense circle in the blink of an eye. There was no need to waste time on the road.

The Universal Treasure technology provided by the Saint Tyracles Race, the 'Space Constant Debugger', had already been improved by Han Xiao. Once it was used, it shone brilliantly, and the effect of the Lerbo Space Protection Belt was directly neutralized.

The shortening of space was extremely helpful to the Galactic Alliance Army, and the World Tree Civilization's expression changed.

"Follow me!"

After doing this, Han Xiao spun the Emperor Skysplitter Blade, and the enormous Supreme Heavenly Venerate mechanical body charged forward, tearing apart the World Tree fleet's formation. Psionic waves splashed out like they were worthless, paralyzing the enemy ships one after another.

The Beyond Grade As followed closely behind with solemn expressions, continuing to deal the finishing blow. Everyone seemed to have formed a sharp blade that stabbed into the World Tree's defense circle.

Wherever they passed, the World Tree battleships exploded!

Such an arrogant advance immediately encountered the large-scale focus fire of the World Tree fleet, and the Galactic Alliance Army fearlessly protected them from the side, providing cover.

Just as Han Xiao was about to pierce through the outermost layer of defense, another Transcendent Grade fluctuation suddenly descended and swept through the entire place like a hurricane.

The Ancestral Tree King had already abandoned himself and burned the Beyonder's Vestige in his inventory to activate the Tree God's Descent.

If there was no Transcendent like Black Star among the enemies, the Ancestral Tree King would still have room to maneuver. He could use the Information Form rebirth mechanism of the Tree God to make the World Tree look defeated on the surface, but in reality, it would be reborn elsewhere and return to the dark to recuperate.

However, in front of the Transcendent Grade Information Form Obliteration, this path was no longer possible. Furthermore, as long as the Pivotal Snake was not destroyed, the World Tree would have nowhere to hide. The Ancestral Tree King no longer had a way out.

At this moment, the Tree God, who was only driven by instinct, led the remaining high-level combatants of the World Tree to face Han Xiao and the others head-on. All of them erupted with a tragic fighting spirit.

"Even if I die in battle, I won't let you pass!"

"Kill!"

Now that the enemies had met, there was no need for any unnecessary words.

Bang!

Without any hesitation, Han Xiao charged into the Tree God's arms and stabbed him with his knife, forcing the Tree God to run.

The two enormous Transcendent Grade Supers were entangled together and rolled in the battle formation, crushing the starships that filled the sky.

(End of this chapter)
